limits: Read README fully, RepairEscrow.sol function/event list, chain client and routes via signature greps; function bodies of service.py, policy.py, scoring.py and clustering.py were not read line by line.
Frontend evidence is file-level; the 5.5-minute demo video was not reviewed; the GitHub Pages deployment was not fetched.
Verified results quoted in the README (adjusted Rand 0.974, test counts) were not re-run.

Hardcoded secret-like values: backend/app/config.py:33 (default JWT secret, hardcoded secret present), backend/app/config.py:44 (public Anvil test mnemonic, publicly known), docker-compose.yml:9 (db password, hardcoded secret present), backend/tests/conftest.py:184 (test JWT secret, hardcoded secret present).
